dev  — used while tuning the cost model and while deciding which words earn a place
in the shipped lexicon. Numbers on this split are optimistic by construction.
test — held out. No entry in src/text/lexicon.ts was added because of a sentence here,
and no cost constant was tuned against it. This is the split to quote.
Annotations are the author's, checked against ordinary orthographic practice rather
than any single published standard. Word segmentation in these languages has no one
correct answer at the margins — Thai compounds and Burmese particles are judgement
calls — so absolute scores matter less than the gap between approaches measured on
